candidates.description:
Painting of Sanghapal Jataka on the walls of Cave no 1, Ajanta Caves, Maharashtra, India.
In the upper left, the Naga king Sankhapala is sitting on his throne and listening to a wise man (. In the upper right, many men are pulling Sankhapala (depicted in serpent form) by a rope through his nose but is stopped by Aḷara who offers his cows in exchange for Sankhapala's release. In the lower left, Sankhapala invites Aḷara to visit his underwater kingdom. 
The painting has washed out in several places and can be understood only after referring old versions. 

The Ajanta Caves are 30 rock-cut Buddhist cave monuments dating from the second century BCE to about 480 CE in Aurangabad district of Maharashtra state in India. Ajanta Caves are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The caves are universally regarded as masterpieces of Buddhist religious art.

Kasama natin sa talakayan sina Naga City Mayor at former Vice President Leni Robredo, Sen. Bam Aquino, at Baguio City Mayor Benjie Magalong.
Nakasama rin natin sina Naga City IT Officer Ruel Oliver, Metro Clark ICT Council Dr. Francisco Villanueva, Mayor Jarold Peña ng San Jose, Camarines Sur, at ICT Council of Bicol Chairperson Efren Daniel De Leon, kasama ang iba pang ICT councils, startups, investors, at development partners.

Mula sa mga mangingisda na gumagamit ng early warning systems, hanggang sa mga magsasakang nakakatanggap ng real-time weather at market data sa kanilang smartphones—𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗼 𝗻𝗮 𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗱𝗶𝗴𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗹 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝘀𝗮 𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀. 𝗡𝗮𝗻𝗴𝘆𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗿𝗶 𝗻𝗮 𝗶𝘁𝗼.
Pero ang tunay na hamon: 𝗽𝗮𝗮𝗻𝗼 𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻 𝗽𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗹𝗮𝘄𝗮𝗸𝗶𝗻 𝗶𝘁𝗼 𝘀𝗮 𝗯𝘂𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝗯𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗮—𝗹𝗮𝗹𝗼 𝗻𝗮 𝘀𝗮 𝗹𝗶𝗯𝗹𝗶𝗯 𝗻𝗮 𝗺𝗴𝗮 𝗸𝗼𝗺𝘂𝗻𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗱?
Kailangan natin ng mas maayos na internet connectivity sa kanayunan, mas pinalakas na agricultural extension services, integrated data systems para sa food security at climate response, at matibay na ugnayan ng LGUs, national government, academe, at private sector.
Dahil sa huli, 𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝘀𝗲𝗰𝘂𝗿𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗱𝗶 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗵𝗼 𝗻𝗴 𝗶𝗶𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝗲𝗸𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗹𝗮𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗴—𝗶𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝘆 𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗮-𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗱 𝗻𝗴 𝗯𝘂𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗯𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗻.
Sa tulong ng ICT at innovation, mas nagiging posible ang isang Pilipinas na handa sa climate shocks, mas matatag ang agrikultura, at siguradong may pagkain sa hapag ng bawat pamilyang Pilipino.

Dios mabalos sa Naga City at sa lahat ng partners sa patuloy na pagsusulong ng isang mas matalino, mas matatag, at mas inklusibong kinabukasan para sa ating bansa. 🇵🇭

Masaya tayong makasama ang mga ICT leaders, innovators, local chief executives, academe partners, at development stakeholders sa 𝟭𝟬𝘁𝗵 𝗖𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗘𝘅: 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗟𝘂𝘇𝗼𝗻 𝗜𝗖𝗧 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗺𝗽𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗘𝘅𝗵𝗶𝗯𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗗𝗶𝗮𝗹𝗼𝗴𝘂𝗲 sa Naga City ngayong araw, June 19.
Kasama natin sa talakayan sina Naga City Mayor at former Vice President Leni Robredo, Sen. Bam Aquino, at Baguio City Mayor Benjie Magalong.
Nakasama rin natin sina Naga City IT Officer Ruel Oliver, Metro Clark ICT Council Dr. Francisco Villanueva, Mayor Jarold Peña ng San Jose, Camarines Sur, at ICT Council of Bicol Chairperson Efren Daniel De Leon, kasama ang iba pang ICT councils, startups, investors, at development partners.
Sa gitna ng hamon ng climate change at food security, malinaw ang mensahe: 𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗯𝘂𝗸𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗻 𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗴𝗮 𝗸𝗼𝗺𝘂𝗻𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗱 𝗮𝘆 𝗻𝗮𝗸𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗹𝗮𝘆 𝘀𝗮 𝗽𝗮𝗴𝗴𝗮𝗺𝗶𝘁 𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗴𝗵𝗮𝗺, 𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗼𝘀, 𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗲𝗸𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗵𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗮 𝘀𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝘀 𝗲𝗽𝗶𝘀𝘆𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲 𝗮𝘁 𝗶𝗻𝗸𝗹𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝗽𝗮𝗺𝗮𝗺𝗮𝗵𝗮𝗹𝗮.
Mula sa mga mangingisda na gumagamit ng early warning systems, hanggang sa mga magsasakang nakakatanggap ng real-time weather at market data sa kanilang smartphones—𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗼 𝗻𝗮 𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗱𝗶𝗴𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗹 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝘀𝗮 𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀. 𝗡𝗮𝗻𝗴𝘆𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗿𝗶 𝗻𝗮 𝗶𝘁𝗼.
Pero ang tunay na hamon: 𝗽𝗮𝗮𝗻𝗼 𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻 𝗽𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗹𝗮𝘄𝗮𝗸𝗶𝗻 𝗶𝘁𝗼 𝘀𝗮 𝗯𝘂𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝗯𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗮—𝗹𝗮𝗹𝗼 𝗻𝗮 𝘀𝗮 𝗹𝗶𝗯𝗹𝗶𝗯 𝗻𝗮 𝗺𝗴𝗮 𝗸𝗼𝗺𝘂𝗻𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗱?
Kailangan natin ng mas maayos na internet connectivity sa kanayunan, mas pinalakas na agricultural extension services, integrated data systems para sa food security at climate response, at matibay na ugnayan ng LGUs, national government, academe, at private sector.
Dahil sa huli, 𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝘀𝗲𝗰𝘂𝗿𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗱𝗶 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗵𝗼 𝗻𝗴 𝗶𝗶𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝗲𝗸𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗹𝗮𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗴—𝗶𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝘆 𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗮-𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗱 𝗻𝗴 𝗯𝘂𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗯𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗻.
Sa tulong ng ICT at innovation, mas nagiging posible ang isang Pilipinas na handa sa climate shocks, mas matatag ang agrikultura, at siguradong may pagkain sa hapag ng bawat pamilyang Pilipino.

Dios mabalos sa Naga City at sa lahat ng partners sa patuloy na pagsusulong ng isang mas matalino, mas matatag, at mas inklusibong kinabukasan para sa ating bansa. 🇵🇭

Masaya tayong makasama ang mga ICT leaders, innovators, local chief executives, academe partners, at development stakeholders sa 𝟭𝟬𝘁𝗵 𝗖𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗘𝘅: 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗟𝘂𝘇𝗼𝗻 𝗜𝗖𝗧 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗺𝗽𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗘𝘅𝗵𝗶𝗯𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗗𝗶𝗮𝗹𝗼𝗴𝘂𝗲 sa Naga City ngayong araw, June 19.
Kasama natin sa talakayan sina Naga City Mayor at former Vice President Leni Robredo, Sen. Bam Aquino, at Baguio City Mayor Benjie Magalong.
Nakasama rin natin sina Naga City IT Officer Ruel Oliver, Metro Clark ICT Council Dr. Francisco Villanueva, Mayor Jarold Peña ng San Jose, Camarines Sur, at ICT Council of Bicol Chairperson Efren Daniel De Leon, kasama ang iba pang ICT councils, startups, investors, at development partners.
Sa gitna ng hamon ng climate change at food security, malinaw ang mensahe: 𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗯𝘂𝗸𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗻 𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗴𝗮 𝗸𝗼𝗺𝘂𝗻𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗱 𝗮𝘆 𝗻𝗮𝗸𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗹𝗮𝘆 𝘀𝗮 𝗽𝗮𝗴𝗴𝗮𝗺𝗶𝘁 𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗴𝗵𝗮𝗺, 𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗼𝘀, 𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗲𝗸𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗵𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗮 𝘀𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝘀 𝗲𝗽𝗶𝘀𝘆𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲 𝗮𝘁 𝗶𝗻𝗸𝗹𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝗽𝗮𝗺𝗮𝗺𝗮𝗵𝗮𝗹𝗮.
Mula sa mga mangingisda na gumagamit ng early warning systems, hanggang sa mga magsasakang nakakatanggap ng real-time weather at market data sa kanilang smartphones—𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗼 𝗻𝗮 𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗱𝗶𝗴𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗹 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝘀𝗮 𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀. 𝗡𝗮𝗻𝗴𝘆𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗿𝗶 𝗻𝗮 𝗶𝘁𝗼.
Pero ang tunay na hamon: 𝗽𝗮𝗮𝗻𝗼 𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻 𝗽𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗹𝗮𝘄𝗮𝗸𝗶𝗻 𝗶𝘁𝗼 𝘀𝗮 𝗯𝘂𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝗯𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗮—𝗹𝗮𝗹𝗼 𝗻𝗮 𝘀𝗮 𝗹𝗶𝗯𝗹𝗶𝗯 𝗻𝗮 𝗺𝗴𝗮 𝗸𝗼𝗺𝘂𝗻𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗱?
Kailangan natin ng mas maayos na internet connectivity sa kanayunan, mas pinalakas na agricultural extension services, integrated data systems para sa food security at climate response, at matibay na ugnayan ng LGUs, national government, academe, at private sector.
Dahil sa huli, 𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝘀𝗲𝗰𝘂𝗿𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗱𝗶 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗵𝗼 𝗻𝗴 𝗶𝗶𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝗲𝗸𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗹𝗮𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗴—𝗶𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝘆 𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗮-𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗱 𝗻𝗴 𝗯𝘂𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗯𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗻.
Sa tulong ng ICT at innovation, mas nagiging posible ang isang Pilipinas na handa sa climate shocks, mas matatag ang agrikultura, at siguradong may pagkain sa hapag ng bawat pamilyang Pilipino.

Dios mabalos sa Naga City at sa lahat ng partners sa patuloy na pagsusulong ng isang mas matalino, mas matatag, at mas inklusibong kinabukasan para sa ating bansa. 🇵🇭
